spec.title: ⏱️ Timing Bias (mean)
spec.description: Signed mean hit offset in ms: negative = tapping early, positive = tapping late, 0 = perfectly on beat. Computed as (late_sum - early_sum) / total_count because the underlying OpenTelemetry histogram only accepts non-negative values and carries the sign on the `hit_direction` label.

spec.expr: ((sum(rate(itgmania_note_hit_offset_ms_milliseconds_sum{hit_direction="late",player_number=~"$player",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) - (sum(rate(itgmania_note_hit_offset_ms_milliseconds_sum{hit_direction="early",player_number=~"$player",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))) / clamp_min(sum(rate(itgmania_note_hit_offset_ms_milliseconds_count{player_number=~"$player",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0), 1)

(itgmania_accuracy_percent_basis_points{player_number=~"$player",instance=~"$instance"} and on (instance, player_number, song_title, song_group, difficulty, meter, steps_type) (itgmania_current_song_info @ end() == 1)) / 100

itgmania_current_combo_notes{player_number=~"$player",instance=~"$instance"} and on (instance, player_number, song_title, song_group, difficulty, meter, steps_type) (itgmania_current_song_info @ end() == 1)

spec.title: ⏱️ Note Timing Heatmap (|ms|)
spec.description:
How far (in milliseconds) your hits land from the beat, regardless of early or late.

How to read it:
- X axis = time, Y axis = how far from the beat in ms (0 = perfectly on beat).
- Each column is one time slice; brighter cells = more hits in that ms band.
- A column concentrated near the bottom = lots of tight, on-beat hits. Bright cells drifting up = looser timing.
- Early vs late is combined here — use the Timing Bias panel below to see if you tend to hit early or late.
- The heatmap shows only finite histogram buckets, with denser bucket edges in the sub-250ms range and a tail for larger outliers.

spec.title: 🎯 Timing Precision (P50/P95 |ms|)
spec.description: Absolute hit timing percentiles - lower = more precise.
